query.description: Filter the report by task date. Allowed values: TaskDate.ThisMonth, TaskDate.ThisWeek, TaskDate.Today, TaskDate.ThisQuarter, TaskDate.ThisYear, TaskDate.PreviousDay, TaskDate.PreviousWeek, TaskDate.PreviousMonth, TaskDate.PreviousQuarter, TaskDate.PreviousYear, and TaskDate.CustomDate.

Sort the report based on the following columns: item_name, sku, entry_number, warehouse (applicable only when multi-warehouse is enabled for the organization), location, created_time, and last_modified_time.
Sort order of the report. Allowed values: A and D.
Page number to be fetched. Default value is 1.
